pnpm.//: Empty allowlist: NO dependency may run an install script. An install hook is the delivery mechanism behind the Shai-Hulud npm compromise, and this repo publishes to npm — a compromised build host signs real releases. Adding a package here is a reviewable security decision.

scripts.//test: Builds first, deliberately: gemwallet-compat's tests import @joeywallet/wallet-sdk, whose exports map points at dist/, so a bare `vitest run` grades whatever was last built. Use test:only when you know dist/ is fresh.
scripts.//verify: What CI runs, and what a release must pass.
scripts.verify: pnpm ts:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test
